name: strix-governance
description: Governed-action skills for Claude Code. strix-wire wires one consequential call site through governedAction(): it asks once for read-only analysis (WIRE-CONSENT-1), then pauses only at the source-change and execution decisions. strix-onboard (ONBOARD-1) is the reference client-onboarding workflow: it pauses only at the governed smoke test and derives readiness from a recorded verifier verdict rather than an operator-set status. Both run with no Strix account; runtime-aware when a Strix runtime is present. The SGRF review lenses are not part of this plugin.
